hero.body: GPT‑Admin is an MCP hub. Plug your servers and any MCP (chrome‑devtools, openmemory) into it, and your favourite AI connects to the hub in one of three ways. Manage everything from web search to spinning up subagents.

author.body1: Hey, I'm not a corporation. I'm a real person doing this solo — for fun and for myself. I've been using the project for over a year; it's more convenient than Codex or Claude for infrastructure work.
author.body2: It's not a full replacement, it's a complement — a tool for servers and admin work. I have 8B tokens in Codex and 2B in Claude, but for my own machines this is faster. Bugs are possible — write me, I'll fix it.

useCases.body: The capabilities come from the hub itself, not from a specific adapter. Whatever AI you connect — Claude, DeepSeek or ChatGPT — it gets access to all of it.

items.title: Server administration
items.body: Restart systemd, firewall, nginx, fail2ban, sshd. Install software, edit configs, open ports — and verify the result.

items.title: Writing and running code
items.body: Edits code, runs checks, can spawn a subagent — "run codex to fix this bug" while you do something else.

items.title: Fix and clean up PRs
items.body: Finds the fork in memory, keeps a single feature commit, runs type-check/lint/build and force-pushes over SSH.

items.title: Log inspection
items.body: Parses journalctl, nginx, postgres logs, finds anomalies, suggests fixes and applies them after confirmation.

items.title: Web search
items.body: Through the chrome-devtools MCP — the agent itself opens pages, reads docs and searches for a solution, without leaving the chat.

items.title: Incident diagnostics
items.body: Finds the failed service itself, reads logs, understands the cause (ECONNREFUSED, 503, OOM) and fixes it — with a report and checks.

adapters.body: These aren't three separate products, they are three adapters to the same hub. Pick the one that fits your AI — capabilities are the same.

items.title: ChatGPT · Open WebUI
items.body: Custom GPT, Open WebUI or Apps SDK widget right in chat. ChatGPT itself figures out when to run a command. No paid Codex limits.

items.title: Claude · Codex · OpenCode
items.body: GPT‑Admin works as MCP remote SSE. Connect it in your client settings — and the AI gets native tool calls across your entire infrastructure.

items.title: DeepSeek · Qwen · Alice
items.body: A userscript for Tampermonkey / Firefox adds MCP buttons to free web AIs. No paid API needed — just a free web chat.
